messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Ahmed <sana@acmeai.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-lead rescope matrix & QBR runway asks

Team —

Attached is a first pass at a rescope matrix for the mid-quarter checkpoint and a short QBR runway deck (v0.3). Purpose: identify which OKR sub-items we can reasonably deprioritize vs keep, and surface the critical cross-team dependencies we need committed before the QBR in three weeks. High-level asks: 

- Review the matrix tabs relevant to your area (Product: columns B-D; Eng: E-G; Ops: H-I) and flag any items where the proposed priority doesn't match your risk view.
- For each dependency row, add an owner and ETA. If you cannot commit, mark "blocked" and add a short reason.
- Vanessa / Markus: please provide optimistic + conservative runway estimates for the two model-serving initiatives by EOD Monday (9/13).
- Laura: can you confirm whether we have capacity to front-load the infra work into the next sprint (Sprints 15/16)?

Attachments: 20260910-rescope-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 88 KB); qbr-runway-deck-v0.3.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB). Drive link is included in the sheet for inline comments.

I'll consolidate inputs Tuesday morning and propose the leadership ask for the QBR readout.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-lead rescope matrix & QBR runway asks

Priya — quick notes after a first pass on the sheet: 

- Product accepts the proposed deprioritization of the "embed-service A/B" experiment (row 12); value / effort tradeoff skews low this quarter given model variance.
- We cannot deprioritize the latency-improvement story (row 3) because it blocks a sales pilot for Acme. Suggest shifting non-blocking telemetry work to next quarter to free up 1.5 engineer-weeks.
- On runway estimates: optimistic = 3w (if we get infra slot), conservative = 5w (if infra delayed). I'll add the numbers into the matrix under "Product ETA".

One question: can someone confirm whether Dedicated capacity can be used for the pilot to reduce latency risk (temporary)? Markus — can you weigh in?

Best,
Vanessa
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-lead rescope matrix & QBR runway asks

Folks —

Thanks Priya for pulling this together. Engineering notes after looking at rows 2-6: 

- Latency-improvement (row 3): engineering estimate aligns with Vanessa's optimistic/conservative split. Critical dependency: infra capacity (slot request #IR-472, see matrix). Without a dedicated slot we need to rework batching config, which adds ~2w uplift in dev/testing.
- Model-serving infra changes (row 4): driver work is ~3 engineer-weeks; migration risk constrained to one weekend if we get a pre-prod window.
- Resource ask: to hit optimistic runway we need 0.6 FTE from infra (sprint 15) + 1.0 FTE from backend (sprint 15-16). If we can’t get infra, the conservative timeline applies.

I updated the matrix with owner tags and wrote short risk notes in the comments.

Markus
Head of Engineering, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

- We have one pre-prod infra maintenance window available in Sprint 15 (week of 9/20) but it is already 60% booked. We can free the slot if the priority is confirmed by Tuesday EOD (9/14).
- On Dedicated capacity: procurement path looks possible but requires a PO and a 10-day lead for instance provisioning; so it's not a fast mitigation for the latency pilot unless procurement expedites.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Ahmed <sana@acmeai.com>, QBR Program Ops <qbr-ops@customersuccess.com>, Procurement Team <procure@acmeai.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-lead rescope matrix & QBR runway asks — consolidated decisions

Thanks for the fast turn on this. Consolidating decisions and next steps for the readout: 

1) Prioritization decisions (final):
   - Keep: Latency-improvement (row 3) — critical for Acme pilot and sales momentum.
   - Defer: embed-service A/B experiment (row 12) to next quarter.

2) Commitments needed: 
   - Laura: hold the Sprint 15 pre-prod window pending confirmation (mark as reserved by 9/14).
   - Markus: allocate 0.6 FTE infra + 1.0 FTE backend if pre-prod window held.
   - Vanessa: finalize product acceptance criteria for the latency pilot by Monday (9/13).

3) Risk & mitigation:
   - If procurement can't provision Dedicated quickly enough, we will run the pilot on a provisioned Hosted tier but with stricter throttling and a fallback plan (rollback to quantized model). Sana, can your team accept a hosted pilot under these conditions?

4) QBR readout ask: I will present the decision matrix and highlight dependency asks. Tessa — please add a one-slide summary to the QBR deck: "Ask: infra slot + 1.6 FTE across sprints; impact if not granted." I'll drop the updated slide and matrix into the Drive link.

I'll circulate a final v0.4 of the deck Monday morning with the committed owners and ETAs. If anyone can't meet the commitments above, flag immediately.

Priya Natarajan
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachment: qbr-runway-deck-v0.4 (will upload Monday)
